summary: The user-authorized Fe(110) C*+H* coadsorption candidates A, B, and C passed input and remote-hash preflight and were submitted as LSF jobs 9715450, 9715451, and 9715455; all were scheduler RUN at the submission checkpoint.

payload.objective: Relax and compare three Fe(110) C*+H* coadsorption candidates for selecting the C* + H* -> CH* + * initial state.
current_evidence: Candidate A is LSF job 9715450 and was scheduler RUN on 32*gknew054 at the submission checkpoint.
Candidate B is LSF job 9715451 and was scheduler RUN on 32*gknew022 at the submission checkpoint.
Candidate C is LSF job 9715455 and was scheduler RUN on 32*gknew043 at the submission checkpoint.

All three packages use the active true Fe(110) five-layer routine-production branch: PBE/PAW-PBE, ENCUT 400 eV, Gamma 5x5x1, ISMEAR 1, SIGMA 0.20 eV, EDIFFG -0.02 eV/A, 32 cores, Fe45/C1/H1, and bottom 18 Fe fixed.
Local and remote input SHA-256 values match, and every remote POTCAR resolves to the accepted Fe_C_H PAW-PBE hash.
Scheduler RUN does not establish electronic convergence, ionic convergence, geometry validity, energy ordering, or scientific acceptance.
payload.one_executable_step: At the next requested checkpoint, inspect jobs 9715450, 9715451, and 9715455; after terminal states, collect final files and separately validate electronic convergence, ionic force convergence, retained C*+H* chemistry, final sites, duplicate structures, and compatible TOTEN values.
payload.submission_boundary: Do not stop, restart, resubmit, launch final statics, or begin NEB/DIMER/frequency work without new evidence and explicit user authority.
done_when: All three jobs reach scheduler terminal states and their outputs are collected with hashes.
Each final structure receives convergence, geometry, chemistry, site, duplicate, and compatibility review.
A reviewed C*+H* initial state is selected for the later transition-state workflow.
